journal.we_definition: One attempted endpoint assembly at <=78465 time nodes costs1WE; each JVP direction costs1 additionalWE. Coarse assemblies conservatively cost the same as a maximum-grid assembly. Actual dispatches, directional lanes, time nodes, Q-pregrid transforms/bytes, FFT and reduction traversals are separately logged. Tokens are not FLOPs or performance-normalized units.
journal.mixed_direction: d=(1,-1,1,-1,1,100)*1e-5 physical units; NoLoop dense q8 at theta +/-d and +/-d/2 on the same fixed time grids
journal.stop: selected regressions must pass first; stop on unresolved numerical or derivative mismatch, unavailable support, resource limit or method fallback. No inference, checkpoint retraining, production default change, or new interpolation programme.
journal.reference_limitations: Existing paper independent full-frequency oracle evidence is source-reported. This bounded real-case check reuses original bank and compares both implementations and q8->q16; it does not generate a new full-frequency capture or claim universal absolute physical accuracy. Paper validation budgets differ from stricter gates here.
